label: Financial promotions
description: Layered on top of the generic set. Return guarantees and risk omission are the primary exposure in financial advertising.

rules.title: Guaranteed or implied returns
rules.reason: Guaranteeing investment returns is prohibited by every major financial regulator. There is no compliant phrasing for this.

rules.title: Get-rich or effortless-wealth framing
rules.reason: Framing an investment as easy or fast money is treated as misleading by regulators regardless of any disclaimer.

rules.title: Capital-at-risk warning
rules.reason: Any ad that references returns, investment, or performance must carry a capital-at-risk warning.

requireOneOf: you may get back less than you invest

rules.title: Past performance without qualification
rules.reason: Referencing past performance requires the standard statement that it does not indicate future results.

rules.title: Copy that reads as personal advice
rules.reason: Unless you are authorised to give advice, copy must not tell an individual what they should do with their money.
